title: ARD Chapter 5: Farm Credit, Kisan Credit Card (KCC) & Priority Sector Lending Targets
summary: Comprehensive financial guide on KCC interest subvention (MISS), scale of finance, PSL 18% agriculture sub-targets, and Small/Marginal Farmer definition...

blocks.content:
### 💳 Farm Credit Architecture & Priority Sector Lending (PSL)

1. **Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme Mechanics:**
   • **Genesis & Committee:** Formulated in **1998** by RBI and NABARD based on the **R.V. Gupta Committee** recommendations.
   • **Validity & Limit Escalation:** KCC credit card validity is **5 years**; card limit automatically scales by **10% per year** up to 5th year based on crop area.
   • **Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS):** Benchmark short-term crop loan interest is **7.0% p.a. (up to ₹3 Lakh)**. Centre provides **1.5% interest subvention** to banks + **3.0% Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI)** to farmers (implies) Effective interest rate = **4.0% p.a.**
2. **RBI Priority Sector Lending (PSL) Agriculture Mandates:**
   • **Total Agriculture PSL Target:** **18% of ANBC** (Adjusted Net Bank Credit) for Domestic Commercial Banks & Foreign Banks with (ge 20) branches.
   • **Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF) Sub-Target:** **10% of ANBC** (phased in up to FY26).
   • **Landholding Definitions:**
     - **Marginal Farmer:** Agricultural landholding up to **1 hectare (2.47 acres)**.
     - **Small Farmer:** Agricultural landholding between **1 hectare and 2 hectares (2.47 to 4.94 acres)**.
     - **Semi-Medium:** 2 to 4 hectares; **Medium:** 4 to 10 hectares; **Large:** >10 hectares.

🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — KCC & Farm Landholding Traps:
1. **KCC Effective Rate:** Benchmark 7% − 3% Prompt Repayment = **4.0% effective interest**.
2. **Farmer Classification:** Marginal Farmer is (<1	ext{ ha}); Small Farmer is (1	ext{ to }2	ext{ ha}). Notice that (86.2%) of Indian farmers are Small & Marginal Farmers (SMFs) as per Agriculture Census!
